failures: Unrecorded interface change. docs/PLAN.md T3.1 Produces says Tools(store, retriever, memory, as_of_seq) and guard_card(card, store, as_of_seq). The code has Tools(store, retriever, memory, as_of_seq, conv_id, checker=None) at src/contextlens/agents/tools.py:11-19 and guard_card(card, store, as_of_seq, conv_id) at src/contextlens/guard/citations.py:9. The extra conv_id is justified (the store is keyed by conversation and Card carries no id), but the plan, the T3.2/T4.1/T7.1 sections and the task notes do not record it. Fix: update the Produces text in docs/PLAN.md (and any callers' text in T3.2 and T4.1 that names these signatures) to match, or conform the code, so the later tasks do not fail on a TypeError.
notes: Beyond the failure above, none block T3.1. (1) Tools returns raw Turn/MemoryItem/ScoredTurn objects; the tool results that T3.2 and T4.1 send back to a model must go through escape()/transcript_block, and nothing here enforces that. (2) A guard that raises on a store error leaves T3.2 to catch it and return an abstained card. (3) The guard keeps a card's suggestion text unverified whenever any finding survives; a hostile suggestion tied to a dropped finding is retained. (4) A card with status abstained that still carries findings keeps them. (5) A model that quotes the escaped form (e.g. '<') will not match the raw turn text and the finding is dropped, which is the safe direction. (6) get_prompt accepts traversal aliases; a bare-name check would stop an alias string being recorded as the version. (7) tests do not cover check_consistency with future ids, the 'It has always been Wednesday' case, an out-of-range confidence, or get_prompt errors; my own script confirmed the behaviour but it is not in the suite. (8) v1/recall.md is unused.
